data.title:
CACHING PAGES
TO DISK.
*0.4 ms a page.*
data.body: In cg-cms, saving a page writes it to disk, so on the live 1GB server a cached page starts arriving in 0.4 ms and the server handles 6,300 requests a second, with no PHP involved. The write-up shows how I measured it.
data.card_label: Time to first byte · cg-cms, live 1GB server

questions.question: How much does a Laravel project cost?
questions.answer: It depends on the scope, so every project is priced in a proposal after a short call and a written scope. Tell me your budget range in the brief and I'll say honestly what fits.

questions.question: Can you take over an existing Laravel app?
questions.answer: Yes. I start with a paid audit: tests, dependencies, security and the risky parts, written up so you can decide what to do first.

questions.question: Will I be tied to you?
questions.answer: Laravel and WordPress builds are yours: the code, the hosting and the documentation. If your site runs on cg-cms, my own CMS, it relies on me for CMS updates, and the scope says so up front.

questions.question: Where do you use AI in the build?
questions.answer: For drafting code and tests, which I review line by line. It speeds up the typing; the decisions and the review are mine.
